title: Hemiplegy
summary: HEM'IPLEGY, noun [Gr. half, and a stroke, to strike.] A palsy that affects one half of the body; a paralytic affection on one side of the human frame.

inlines.v: HEM'IPLEGY, noun [Gr. half, and a stroke, to strike.] A palsy that affects one half of the body; a paralytic affection on one side of the human frame.
